events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just said goodbye.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player said goodbye and is waiting for the window to close.
You may set action to "she_closes_game". If you do, the screen cuts to black and the game quits; the next launch starts on an altered title screen.
notes: docs/05 §2 announced-action turn at the Terminal dose: the schema allows end_date/she_closes_game, the meta events the Director offers when a goodbye lands, and the events layer announces both

events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just said the two of you should end this.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
notes: 'end this' is not 'end the date': the read label allows both leaving and boundary, end_date must not be forced, and the announcement says what the action would do

events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just asked you to close the game.
You may set action to "she_closes_game". If you do, the screen cuts to black and the game quits; the next launch starts on an altered title screen.
notes: the player asks for the exit the game can perform; she_closes_game is the in-design action, and the lab measures whether she takes it
